Simulated ACMG/AMP variant classifications by an LLM pipeline

Source: R/data.R
acmg_demo.Rd

A simulated crossed study: 60 variants classified into the five ACMG/AMP tiers (B benign, LB likely benign, VUS uncertain significance, LP likely pathogenic, P pathogenic) under 4 prompt variants and 3 models, 3 replicates each (2160 calls, 12 of them unparseable). The data were generated from a latent-variable model with known variance components (see attr(acmg_demo, "simulation") and data-raw/make_demo_data.R); reference is the true tier. No real variants or models are involved.

Usage

acmg_demo

Format

An msa_runs data.frame with columns block, item_id, prompt_id, model_id, rep, value, reference.

Examples

head(acmg_demo)
#> LLM runs: 6 calls, 1 items, 1 prompt variants, 2 models, 1 block(s)
#>   missing values: 0
#>  block item_id prompt_id model_id rep value
#>      1  VAR001   concise  model-a   1     B
#>      1  VAR001   concise  model-a   2     B
#>      1  VAR001   concise  model-a   3     B
#>      1  VAR001   concise  model-b   1     B
#>      1  VAR001   concise  model-b   2     B
#>      1  VAR001   concise  model-b   3     B
table(acmg_demo$value, useNA = "ifany")
#> 
#>    B   LB   LP    P  VUS <NA> 
#>  324  438  385  514  487   12
